description: Move XAGI public website to GitHub Pages; preserve separate product routes
expression: (http.host in {"xagi.in" "www.xagi.in"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bookreels") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/openmusic") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/simpleshot") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/drone-sim") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ram-japa-counter"))
